rules.title: runBlocking on the main thread
rules.description: `runBlocking` blocks the calling thread; on the main thread it freezes the UI and can trigger an ANR.
Work launched in `GlobalScope` is never cancelled and outlives the component that started it.

rules.title: Not-null assertion on a nullable value
rules.description: `!!` throws a NullPointerException when the value is null at runtime.

rules.title: Code that always throws
rules.description: A call that throws on every path, often because a precondition is no longer set up.

rules.title: A change removes input validation
rules.description: Removing a `require` or `check` lets invalid input through.

rules.title: An if/else only returns its condition
rules.description: Return the condition instead of branching on it.

rules.title: Public API still used by a consumer
rules.description: A change removes public API that a consumer repository still calls.
